assay: bulk poly-A mRNA-seq, vastus lateralis, NextSeq 2000 2x50 bp; STAR 2.7.8a GRCh38, Ensembl 99 quantification in Partek Flow (S2.9.p2-p3)
sample_inclusion: biopsies ~60 min pre-exercise and 180 min post-exercise in each of 2 trials (S2.7.p1) -> 36 biopsies
sample_exclusion: participant excluded for drink error (S2.1.p1); no sample-level outlier removal reported in the paper

factors.name: time
levels: POST (180 min after 90 min cycling at 60% VO2max)

repeated_measure_unit: participant (4 biopsies each); within each trial a PRE/POST pair from the same visit
primary_estimand: Effect of an acute 90-min aerobic exercise bout (180 min recovery) on vastus lateralis gene expression (POST vs PRE, within participant), and whether KME modifies it

planned_contrast_labels.time_POST_vs_PRE_pooled: Exercise effect: 180 min POST vs PRE (~60 min pre-exercise), pooled over KME and PLA trials, within visit (ABS.p3: 1561 DEGs, 909 up / 652 down)
planned_contrast_labels.time_POST_vs_PRE_cond-PLA: Exercise effect within the placebo trial (S3.4.p1 / FIG4C: per-condition POST vs PRE log2FC)
planned_contrast_labels.time_POST_vs_PRE_cond-KME: Exercise effect within the ketone-ester trial (S3.4.p1 / FIG4C)
planned_contrast_labels.cond_time_KME_POST_vs_PLA_PRE: Condition x time interaction: does KME change the exercise response (paper: no gene at FDR 0.05)
planned_contrast_labels.cond_KME_vs_PLA_time-POST: KME vs PLA at POST (paper: KME did not regulate any gene, S3.4.p1)

blocking_or_covariance.note: within-subject crossover; paper also ran lmerseq mixed models 'appropriate for within-subject RNA-seq designs' (S2.9.p3)

matrix_scale: Partek 'filtered raw counts' (S2.9.p3); GEO deposits Partek transcript-level estimated counts and a DESeq2-normalized gene matrix with outliers removed
paper_method: DESeq2 in Partek Flow (S2.9.p3); lmerseq sensitivity (S2.9.p3, S3.4.p1)
paper_formula: not_reported (Partek DESeq2 model terms not printed)
paper_prefilter: 'filtered raw counts' - filter rule not_reported; 16,898 genes measured (ABS.p3, S4.p1)

paper_threshold.note: 'significantly different ... when FDR q < 0.05 and fold change (FC) > 1.5' (S2.9.p3); ABS.p3 'q < 0.05 fold change > +/- 1.5'

paper_reported_deg_counts.note: S3.4.p1 also calls the 1561 'overlapped DEGs between conditions'; ABS.p3 calls them DEGs 'post vs pre-exercise'
